title: Constellation roadmap
description: Schema for the project tracker at roadmap.json. Edits to roadmap.json must conform to this contract. additionalProperties:false everywhere — do not invent new fields; update this schema in the same commit if a new shape is genuinely needed.

$schema.description: Pointer to this schema file. Keep as './roadmap.schema.json' so editors auto-validate.

right_now.description: One sentence on what you're actively working on this session. Re-read when you sit down. Keep it short — replace it when you switch tasks.

short_term.description: Goals you'd ship in the next few days if nothing else came up.

mid_term.description: Bigger bets that aren't urgent but you want to land soon (next few weeks).

long_term.description: Where Constellation is going. May take months.

recently_shipped.description: What just shipped. Prune items older than ~2 weeks — git log remembers.

known_issues.description: Bugs or rough edges you've noticed but aren't fixing right now. Visible so they don't get forgotten.

open_questions.description: Decisions you want to think through before committing.

anti_goals.description: Things explicitly out of scope. Helps say 'no' to scope creep.

parked_ideas.description: Ideas you've thought of but aren't goals yet. A graveyard so you can let go without forgetting.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier, unique within the section. Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens only.

title.description: Short imperative phrase describing the goal.

status.description: queued = not started; in_progress = actively working; blocked = waiting on something. Closed enum — do not invent new values.

notes.description: Optional context — why this matters, what's tricky, what to watch out for.

files.description: Optional list of repo-relative paths most relevant to this goal.

plan.description: Optional path to a plan doc, e.g. 'docs/plans/2026-05-03-...md'.

commit.description: Optional short commit SHA (7–40 hex chars).
